data.title: The Cynic | A Celtic FC Podcast
data.description: The Cynic is the home of independent Celtic FC podcasts, bringing supporters in-depth analysis, honest debate and coverage of everything happening at Celtic Football Club.The Cynic provides a unique perspective on one of football’s most passionate clubs and features a team of dedicated hosts, supporters and expert contributors. We cover everything from match reactions and tactical breakdowns to transfer discussions and recruitment analysis.Whether you want post-match analysis or the latest news from Paradise, The Cynic delivers independent Celtic FC coverage every week.
